No. HCM.11/96/2026/Comp/.3:l.f>l '-_: For the effective implementation of the Standard
Operating Procedure (SOP) governing the operation and utilisation of the Mobile e-
Sewa Kendra Vans, and with a view to ensuring seamless coordination among the
stakeholders, systematic deployment of the Vans, and regular monitoring of the
services provided through these facilities, the Hon'ble Computer Committee is
pleased to nominate Smti Artyksiar Mary Kharbuki, Manager (IT), as the Nodal Officer
for the supervision, coordination, implementation and monitoring of the Mobile e-
Sewa Kendra facilities .
